[[Euric]] will move into a cellar under the [[Souls room]], but you will need to repair the broken furniture in his room. Upon completeing the room's repairs, you will receive {{Money|10000}} and a large cathedral window that will be automatically installed in the [[Church]]. After using the charged sins on [[Euric]], you can then add them to the cathedral window. Each of the charged sins will depict a scene from the history of the person you got each sin from.
